JUSTICE (Legislative Department) NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the 25th July, 2025 S.O. 3402(E).— In pursuance of section 67 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 (43 of 1951), the following declaration containing the name of the candidates elected to fill the seats in the Council of States of six members, who retired on 24th July, 2025, on the expiration of their term of office, is published for general information:– Declaration Election to the Council of States by the elected members of the Legislative Assembly of the State of Tamil Nadu. “In pursuance of the provisions contained in sub-section (2) of section 53 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951, read with sub-rule (1) of rule 11 of the Conduct of Elections Rules, 1961, I declare that— 1. Thiru. I.S. Inbadurai, Sponsored by All India 7-28, South Street, Anna Dravida Munnetra Navaladi Post, Kazhagam Thisaiyanvilai Taluk, Tirunelveli – 627 657. 2. Thiru. S.R. Sivalingam, Sponsored by Dravida 4/25, Sivasami Street, Munnetra Kazhagam Salem – 636 001. 3. Thiru. M. Dhanapal, Sponsored by All India 1/1, Vasuvasamuthiram Road, Anna Dravida Munnetra Prabilimedu, Pudupattinam, Kazhagam Kalpakkam Post, Chengalpattu – 603 103. 4. Tmt. Rajathi, Sponsored by Dravida 6A/2, Muslim East Street, Munnetra Kazhagam Ponnampatti Town Panchayat, Thuvarankurichi Post Tiruchirappalli District– 621 314. 5. Thiru. P. Wilson, Sponsored by Dravida 10, Railway Colony, Munnetra Kazhagam 4th Street, off Nelson Manickam Road, Chennai – 600 029. 6. Thiru. Kamal Haasan, Sponsored by Makkal New No.4, Old No.172, Needhi Maiam Eldams Road, Teynampet, Chennai – 600 018. have been duly elected to fill the seats in that House of six members retiring on 24th July, 2025 on the expiration of their term of office. Place: Chennai – 600 009. Date :12.06.2025 Sd- Returning Officer”. [F. No. H.11024/6/2025-Leg.II] Dr. RAJIV MANI, Secy. -- 3 of 4 -- 4 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] अजधसूचना नई दिल्ली , 25 िुलाई, 2025 का.आ. 3403(अ).— लोक प्र जतजनजधत्ि अजधजनयम, 1951 (1951 का 43) की धारा 12 के अधीन िारी की गई अजधसूचना संखयांक का.आ. 2446(अ), तारीख 2 िून, 2025 के अनुसरण में, तजमलनाडु राज्य की जिधान सभा के जनिााजचत सिस्ट्यों द्व ारा जनिााजचत राज्य सभा के छह सिस्ट्यों के स्ट् थानों को , िो छह सिस्ट्यों की पिािजध के अिसान पर, तारीख 24 िुलाई, 2025 को जनिृत्त होने पर ठरक्त हो गए हैं, भरने के प्र योिन के जलए जनिााचन कराया गया है; अत:, अब, लोक प्र जतजनजधत्ि अजधजनयम, 1951 (1951 का 43) की धारा 71 के अनुसरण में, तजमलनाडु राज्य की जिधान सभा के जनिााजचत सिस्ट्यों द्व ारा जनिााजचत सिस्ट्यों के नाम सिासाधारण की िानकारी के जलए अजधसूजचत दकए िाते हैं :-- क्र . सं. सिस्ट्य का नाम 1. जथरु. आई. एस. इनबािुरई 2. जथरु. एस. आर. जििाललंगम 3. जथरु. एम. धनपाल 4. तिरुमिी रािाथी 5. जथरु. पी. जिल्सन 6. जथरु. कमल हासन [फा. सं. एच.11024/6/2025-जि.-2] डॉ. रािीि मजण, सजचि NOTIFICATION New Delhi, the 25th July, 2025 S.O. 3403(E).— Whereas election has been held, in pursuance of notification number S.O. 2446 (E), dated the 2nd June, 2025 issued under section 12 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 (43 of 1951), for the purpose of filling the seats of six members of the Council of States elected by the elected members of the Legislative Assembly of the State of Tamil Nadu which fell vacant on the retirement of six members on the expiration of their term of office on 24th July, 2025. Now, therefore, in pursuance of section 71 of the Representation of the People Act, 1951 (43 of 1951), the name of the members elected by the elected members of the Legislative Assembly of the State of Tamil Nadu are hereby notified for general information:- Sl. No. Name of the Member 1. Thiru. I.S. Inbadurai 2. Thiru. S.R. Sivalingam 3. Thiru. M. Dhanapal 4. Tmt. Rajathi 5. Thiru. P. Wilson 6. Thiru. Kamal Haasan [F. No. H.11024/6/2025-Leg.II] Dr. RAJIV MANI, Secy.
